name: Google Workspace MCP
description: Enables AI assistants to securely manage Google Workspace services (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets, Contacts) with persistent multi-account OAuth. Uses OS keychain for credential storage with health monitoring and granular business rules for enterprise security.
